newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Dec 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Dec 11.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Ivorian Foreign Minister Amara Essy, candidate for post of U.N. secretary-general, says he is undaunted by the task; says reform is the priority, particularly sorting out the world body's finances; says deep reforms are necessary which would involve staff cuts and suppression of U.N. bodies and institutions.

- Rubber producer Societe Africaine de Plantations d'Heveas (SAPH) chairman and managing director Yves Roland says investors flocking to buy stake in company which is offering 20 percent of its shares on the Abidjan Bourse; offer ends December 27.
- About a dozen Ivorian children benefit from hospital operations carried out under Swiss-Ivorian medical exchange programme.

- Goods train carrying oil products derails in Ivory Coast's commercial capital Abidjan; no-one hurt. - Le Jour publishes messages of support from Internet users worldwide for its decision to publish on the Internet.

- Parliament's finance commission considers 1997 budget in secret; Finance Minister N'Goran Niamien tells legislators that the current balance in public finances remains fragile because of foreign debt and need to control spending.
